theory.heading: What Prompt Templates is
theory.body: Prompt Templates describes the methods and patterns used within Prompt Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Prompt Templates is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Prompt Templates matters
theory.body: Without Prompt Templates, systems built with Prompt Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Prompt Templates works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Prompt Templates follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Prompt Templates.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Prompt Templates
theory.body: Prompt Templates offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
